name: Emily R.
text: Sophia did the most gorgeous balayage on my hair! I've never gotten so many compliments. The salon atmosphere is so relaxing and everyone is incredibly friendly.

name: Marcus T.
text: James is hands down the best barber/stylist I've ever been to. He took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and nailed it. Will definitely be coming back!

name: Priya S.
text: Got a gel manicure from Aaliyah and it looks amazing! It's been two weeks and still no chips. The only reason for 4 stars is the wait was a bit long, but the result was worth it.

name: Jessica M.
text: Olivia did my bridal makeup and I cried happy tears (which didn't ruin a thing!). She made me feel like an absolute queen on my wedding day. Cannot recommend enough!

name: David K.
text: Had a facial with the LED light therapy add-on. My skin has never felt so smooth and refreshed. Great value for the quality of service. Booking again next month!
